applicability: The standalone explainer document, its publication checks and its per-load binding.
conditions: Static readiness, ordinary browser load and media controls still apply.
The ordinary iframe binding still supplies the admitted revision and session.
A resumed interaction report retains current ordinary-pass progress.
exclusions: The dashboard document’s own effects and reduced-motion behavior.
Approval of new media sources or access beyond the frame policy.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/RevisionFrameProtocol.test.tsx::"sends the binding once without an effects field even when dashboard effects start as %s and toggle"

statement: Per D952, explainer pages have no reduced-motion or quiet-mode check: the static prefers-reduced-motion word gate, explainer reduced-motion and effects-off browser passes, motion detector, and explainer ar-canvas-binding/v1 effects flag and dataset.effects bridge are removed so CSS, Web Animations, canvas, rAF, and controlled video publish without motion refusal or remark while the dashboard application keeps its own reduced-motion and quiet behavior unchanged.
